summary: AI-powered web scraping and browser automation has shifted from brittle CSS-selector scripts toward LLM-driven extraction, natural-language queries, and agent-friendly infrastructure that returns clean, structured, model-ready data. Modern tools combine headless browser control (Playwright, Puppeteer) with AI layers that interpret pages semantically, making them resilient to layout changes. The leading platforms now split between developer-first APIs (Firecrawl, Apify, Browserbase) for scale and no-code/visual tools (Browse.ai, Octoparse) for non-engineers.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source (self-hosted); costs only for compute/cloud infrastructure
ai_features: Integrates with LLM agents for natural-language-driven browsing
Works as execution layer for AI browser agents and MCP servers
Codegen and auto-wait reduce brittle selector logic
strengths: Reliable handling of dynamic pages, clicks, and form fills
tools.best_for: Dynamic pages requiring full browser interaction and as the automation backbone for AI agents

tools.name: Puppeteer
ai_features: Commonly paired with LLMs for AI agent browsing
Used as backend for AI scraping pipelines
strengths: Huge GitHub star count and mature ecosystem
Excellent for headless automation and PDF/screenshot generation
tools.best_for: Chromium-based headless automation and scripting dynamic page interactions

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.pricing_paid: Paid plans from ~$16/month (Hobby) up to Standard/Growth tiers (~$83-$333+/month)
ai_features: LLM-ready markdown and structured JSON output
Natural-language extraction and schema-based scraping
Lovable integration for building scraping workflows with natural language
Built for RAG pipelines and AI agents
strengths: Clean, model-ready output out of the box
tools.best_for: Feeding clean web data into LLM and RAG pipelines

tools.name: Apify
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with monthly credits; paid plans from ~$49/month (Starter) to Scale/Business (~$499+/month)
ai_features: AI-powered Actors and LLM integration
Structured data extraction for AI workflows
MCP server support for agents
tools.best_for: Large-scale, maintainable extraction and reusable scraper deployment

tools.name: Browserbase
tools.pricing_paid: Free starter tier; paid plans from ~$39/month with usage-based scaling
ai_features: Headless browser infrastructure for AI agents
Stagehand framework for natural-language browser control
LLM-driven navigation and extraction
strengths: Managed, scalable browser sessions in the cloud
Built specifically for AI web agents
tools.best_for: Running production AI web agents on managed browser infrastructure

tools.name: Bright Data
tools.pricing_paid: Free trial; usage-based and subscription plans starting ~$500/month for enterprise-scale data
ai_features: AI-powered Web Scraper APIs and datasets
Structured extraction endpoints for LLM workflows
MCP server for agent access
strengths: Largest proxy network for extraction at scale
tools.best_for: Enterprise-scale data extraction requiring robust proxy and anti-blocking

tools.name: Selenium
ai_features: Used as execution layer for AI-driven test and scraping agents
Integrates with LLM frameworks for automated browsing
tools.best_for: Cross-browser automation and legacy browser interaction workflows

tools.name: Browse.ai
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; paid plans from ~$19/month (Starter) to Team/Company (~$99-$500+/month)
ai_features: No-code AI robots trained by example
Automatic adaptation to site layout changes
Natural-language configuration and monitoring
strengths: Point-and-click scraper setup with no code
tools.best_for: No-code scraping and website change monitoring for non-engineers

tools.name: AgentQL
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with monthly credits; paid plans from ~$99/month
ai_features: Natural-language / semantic query language to locate elements
AI-powered element selection resilient to DOM changes
LLM-friendly structured data output
strengths: Query web elements by intent rather than selectors
Integrates with Playwright and agent frameworks
tools.best_for: Building resilient AI agents that locate and extract data by semantic intent

tools.name: Octoparse
tools.pricing_paid: Free plan; paid plans from ~$99/month (Standard) to Professional (~$249/month)
ai_features: AI-assisted auto-detection of data fields
Template-based extraction with smart point-and-click
tools.best_for: Non-technical users building visual scrapers without code

tools.name: Diffbot
tools.pricing_paid: Paid plans from ~$299/month; enterprise Knowledge Graph pricing
ai_features: AI/ML automatic extraction APIs (Article, Product, etc.)
Knowledge Graph built from web-wide crawling
Natural-language queries over structured entities
strengths: Fully automated structured extraction without rules
Strong for research and enterprise data
tools.best_for: Automated entity extraction and querying a web-scale knowledge graph
